SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) FROM yearmonth

SELECT c.Segment, substr(y.Date,1,4) AS yr, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment, substr(y.Date,1,4)
ORDER BY c.Segment, yr

SELECT c.Segment,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
